text:
anya: FYI staging promo failing — build 6182 stuck at artifact prefetch step, deploy-bot shows 5xx from artifact-proxy. https://ci.example.com/builds/6182
sam: logs: chunk fetch 504/502 interleaved. snippet:
```
GET /artifacts/sha256:feedface/chunk-12 -> 502 Bad Gateway
curl: (56) recv failure: Connection reset by peer
```
deploy-bot: auto-retries exhausted (6/6); promotion paused.
storage-oncall: we had a rolling proxy restart at 09:02 PT; some multipart streams dropped and left incomplete uploads. rehydration in progress.
anya: change-window at 09:30 PT — product demo at 09:45. options?
pm-ryan: (pm-ryan) prefer not to miss demo; if safe, pin previous canary image. any rollback risk?
sre-oncall: safe short-term: manual promote previous stable sha256:1122aabb. quarantine 6182 for investigation and reupload.
sam: also seeing manifest mismatch on verify when stream resumes; likely incomplete multipart assembly.
anya: decision: promote previous image to meet window. @deploy-bot promote sha256:1122aabb to canary and quarantine 6182. add note: "artifact-proxy restart caused incomplete multipart stream"
deploy-bot: executing: `deploybot promote --env canary --image sha256:1122aabb --reason "artifact-proxy restart incomplete multipart streams"`
deploy-bot: promote complete. canary now on sha256:1122aabb, routing updated. promotion_log: /deploy/logs/7091122334/promote-1122aabb
storage-oncall: will finish rehydrate and run integrity checks; will post when 6182 artifacts verified and ready for rebuild.
pm-ryan: thx. pls note in release notes + inform demo contacts.
anya: closing thread — change-window met. open incident if recurrence within 24h. :thumbsup:
